steps.text: Search the machinery in the north of the elemental workshop.
Unlock the hatch the middle of the workshop.
Go back down to the deeper workshop and use the claw on the crane.
Make a claw from an elemental bar.
Sort the pipes in the junction box on the catwalk.
Use the pipe on the broken pipe to the north of the catwalk.
Place cogs on the pegs outside the wind tunnel.
Make the mind helm.
Search the marked bookcase in the Exam Centre in the Dig Site.
Read the beaten book.
Read the scroll.
Enter the elemental workshop.
Enter the hatch the middle of the workshop.
Take crane schematics from the crate to the south.
Go up the stairs.

You need 2 elemental bars. Mine one of the elemental rocks in the west room, ready to fight a level 35. If you want to smith a mind shield after this quest, get a third elemental ore and also smelt it into a bar.
Kill the rock elemental that appeared.
Pick up the elemental ore.
Use the elemental ores on the furnace in the south room.
Use the bar on one of the workbenches in the central room to make a claw.

items.name: Elemental metal. Bring an additional elemental metal if you want to smith a mind shield after this quest

steps.text: Pull the south west lever to lower the claw.
Use the claw on the crane to the south.
Climb up to the catwalk.
Climb down from the catwalk.
Open the junction box.
Search the marked crates on the catwalk AND DOWN THE STAIRS for 3 cogs and a pipe.
Place the small cog on the top left peg.
Place the medium cog on the bottom left peg.
Place the large cog on the right peg.
Place the elemental bar on the jig cart.

items.name: Elemental metal. Bring an additional elemental metal if you want to smith a mind shield after this quest

steps.text: Pull the south west lever to lower the claw.
Pull the south west lever to raise the claw.
Pull the south east lever to rotate the claw.
Pull the south west lever to lower the claw into the lava.
Pull the south west lever to raise the claw out of the lava.
Pull the south east lever to rotate the claw back.
Pull the south west lever to lower the bar back onto the jig.
Pull the south west lever to raise the claw once more.
Pull the central lever to activate the press.
Pull the west lever to move the jig to the press.
Pull the central lever to move the jig to the water tank.
Pull the north lever to open the water tank.
Turn the corkscrew.
Turn the corkscrew again.
Pull the north lever to close the water tank.
Turn the north west water valve.
Turn the north east water valve.
Turn the north east water valve again.
Turn the north west water valve again.
Pull the north lever to open the water tank again.
Turn the corkscrew.
Turn the corkscrew once more.
Pull the north lever to close the water tank.
Pull the central lever to move the jig to the wind tunnel.
Pull the east lever to start the wind tunnel.
Pull the east lever to stop the wind tunnel.
Pull the central lever to move the jig back to the start.
Pick up the primed bar. If you want to smith a mind shield after this quest, repeat this process one more time.
Go down from the priming room.
Use the primed bar on the extractor gun in the east room.

items.name: Primed bar. Bring an additional primed bar if you want to smith a mind shield after this quest

steps.text: Sit in the extractor chair.
Take the mind bar. If you want to smith a mind shield after this quest, repeat this process one more time.
Go up the stairs.

Use the mind bar on one of the workbenches in the central room with the beaten book in your inventory. If you want to smith a mind shield after this quest, use the remaining mind bar on one of the workbenches with the slashed book in your inventory.
Connect the pipes as marked..
